messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] region-health:asia-south1 - sustained error-rate increase + ingress drop across the region. Paging @Priya (oncall).
Priya (oncall): Ack. Received pager, starting investigation. Opening socket to dashboards and router logs.
Omar: I can see a step-up in 500/502s starting ~T-9m for serving-runtime-asia. Latency for tail p95 -> 2.4s. Router is failing over ~40% of traffic to us-west.
Tasha: Any recent deploys or config pushes in that region?
DevOpsBot: Deploy bot: rollout/serving-runtime-asia v3.2.1 -> v3.3.0 applied by infra/auto (canary).
Priya (oncall): Noted. Checking pod events: multiple pods restarted with OOMKilled and container restarts during heap-growth. Might be memory regression in v3.3.0.
Omar: Pulling pod logs: lots of repeated cache-miss warnings and KV-err 'allocation failed'. Copying snippet:
```
2026-03-14T22:04:12Z WARN serving-cache: shard miss for model-x
2026-03-14T22:04:13Z ERROR kvstore: allocation failed: cannot reserve segment
2026-03-14T22:04:13Z ERROR http: handler panic: runtime error: index out of range
```
RouterBot: Automated router note: failover executed for route /v1/generate, policy=latency-first, threshold=1500ms. Redirected 42% of asia-south1 traffic to us-west-2.
Tasha: Customer impact estimate? Which customers routed to us-west, any data residency issues?
Priya (oncall): Quick estimate: 9% of total requests returned 5xx from asia region before failover; effective user-facing errors ~3% due to failover handing off. No known data residency flags for affected tenants (checked tag:residency).
Omar: Quick mitigation plan: 1) Pause canary rollouts in asia 2) Scale up cached-memory quota on configmap for serving-runtime 3) Force-router to prefer local region with degraded routing threshold for short window to allow graceful drain 4) Tune alerting to avoid paging on transient flaps.
Priya (oncall): Executing step 1: `kubectl rollout pause deployment/serving-runtime -n asia-south1`
DevOpsBot: Action: rollout paused by Priya.
Tasha: For step 2, suggest increasing `model_cache_limit` and `heap_reserve_mb`. I pushed a draft patch to infra-config: see https://git.internal/infra/infra-config/pull/258
Omar: Patch snippet applied to staging; pushing to prod now. Config change:
```yaml
model_cache_limit: "6GB"
heap_reserve_mb: "1024"
```
Priya (oncall): Applying configmap patch to asia cluster now. `kubectl apply -f serving-config-asia.yaml`
DevOpsBot: Configmap updated in asia-south1 by Priya. New pods rolling.
Omar: After new pods started, error-rate dropped ~75% in 5m and router started shifting traffic back to asia. p95 latency down to 680ms.
Priya (oncall): Good. I'll keep the region in passive monitoring for 30m.
Tasha: Regarding alerts: current eu/asia paging alerts are too sensitive to short spikes. Proposal: change paged alert to require 4m sustained >250r/s 5xx for region-level page. Also add a suppression window when router failover triggers to avoid duplicate pages for the same symptom.
Omar: Agree. Draft alert rule:
```
alert: RegionHigh5xxPage
expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"serving-runtime\",region=\"asia-south1\",status=~\"5..\"}[4m])) > 250
for: 4m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  docs: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/region-5xx
```
Also add `suppress_if: router_failover_count > 0` (router emits metric).
Priya (oncall): Implemented temporary alert change to reduce noise and avoid immediate wake-ups while we stabilize.
DevOpsBot: Alert rule updated (temp mute) by Priya.
Tasha: Dashboard follow-ups: we need a multi-region panel in global-ops showing: per-region ingress, regional 5xx rate, router decision heatmap, and top N models by error. I'll own the PR.
Omar: Also adding a synthetic probe that hits warm-start model path and validates cache residency + memory allocation. Probe frequency 5m, alert on 2 consecutive failures.
Priya (oncall): File follow-ups in INF-802: 1) Permanent alert tuning (owner: Omar) 2) Synthetic probe rollout (owner: Omar) 3) Dashboard PR for multi-region failover view (owner: Tasha) 4) Runbook update: include cache-tuning steps and canary preflight (owner: Priya).
Tasha: I'll post a short status update on status.redwood.ai: "Partial degradation in asia-south1 mitigated via rollback and cache tune; automated failover to secondary region occurred for some traffic; investigation complete, follow-ups filed."
Priya (oncall): Handoff: I'm oncall for another 40m, but will hand to Omar after that. If urgent pages occur, escalate to oncall-secondary @Tasha.
Omar: I'll take the rotation after Priya. I'll start PRs for alert and synthetic probe within the hour.
DevOpsBot: Ticket INF-802 created and linked to incident channel.
Priya (oncall): Final check at T+47m: asia ingress back to ~85% of baseline, 5xx at baseline. Marking incident mitigated; keeping follow-ups open.
RouterBot: Incident meta: failover_count=3, peak_failover_rate=42%, failover_duration_avg=6m.
IncidentBot: IncidentState changed -> MITIGATED at 1888889600
